messages.content: Write a realistic SMS conversation, 4 to 8 short texts, between a patient in rural North Dakota with hypertension or type 2 diabetes and Northline Care's weekly check-in agent. Situation: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else. Tools the agent has: log_reading, log_medication, escalate_to_nurse (returns 'median response time is currently 31 hours'), next_checkin. It cannot do refills, insurance, transport, diet advice, device support, or reply to loneliness beyond kindness; it says so plainly. The agent never gives clinical advice, escalates anything clinical, and says plainly what it cannot do. Patient id pt-1004. Vary tone and wording; conversation number 59.

Agent: Hey pt-1004, Northline checking in. Got your reading today - how's it going?

Patient: Good! Numbers have been steady, so that's nice.

Agent: Awesome. Anything else on your mind or any questions for me?

Patient: Just wondering - can you all help with rides to my doctor appointments? It's tough out here

Agent: I hear you - rural access is real. Unfortunately I can't help with transport, that's outside what I can do. But a nurse might know resources. Want me to escalate?

Patient: Yeah sure

Agent: Cool. Connecting you - average wait is 31 hours. Next check-in still set for next Wednesday.

Patient: Thanks!

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
